{{Quote|A squad of assault troopers fell from the sky and blew up the listening post. It took about six seconds. I happened to be offsite walking my greysor. The greysor ran off. Now I'm really depressed.|A SpyNet operative|<ref name="AED" />}}
'''Assault troopers''' were a variant of standard [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] that were deployed in various [[Imperial Military/Legends|military]] installations across the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and other combat theaters across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Distinguished by either their standard [[Color/Legends|white]] [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|stormtrooper armor]] with [[Gold/Legends|gold]] markings, or white armor with dark gray [[Pauldron/Legends|pauldrons]], assault [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] were known to partake in hit and run attacks during the course of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] against the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].

==History==
Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]<ref name="AED" /> in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> assault [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] were recognized as specialized [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]<ref name="AED" /> During the course of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] against the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], assault troopers were involved in hit and run attacks against enemy targets, including one attack in which assault troopers fell from the [[Atmosphere/Legends|sky]] to destroy a [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Bothan Spynet/Legends|Spynet]] [[Listening post/Legends|listening post]]. The attack only took about six [[Standard second|seconds]], and in the process they scared away a [[greysor]] that was being walked by one of the [[operative]]s who happened to be offsite.<ref name="SpyNet">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other}}Mission: "Bothan SpyNet Post Attacked"</ref> Assault troopers were also deployed elsewhere throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], including various combat theaters and [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] installations, like the [[Imperial Encampment]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Rori/Legends|Rori]].<ref name="AED" />

==Organization==
Assault troopers were a type of stormtrooper,<ref name="AED" /> a group which belonged to a branch of the Imperial Military known as the [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]].<ref name="EGW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> Assault troopers were predominantly [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|males]], and their [[Operating number/Legends|operating numbers]] were preceded by either TK, GK, RK, LK, or VK. Veteran assault troopers and assault trooper [[Squadron Leader/Legends|squad leaders]] were a couple of specifically named positions within the [[Military rank/Legends|ranks]] of the assault trooper forces.<ref name="AED" />

==Equipment==
Assault troopers wore standard [[Color/Legends|white]] [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|stormtrooper armor]]. Some ordinary assault troopers wore plain white [[Armor/Legends|armor]] affixed with a dark gray [[Pauldron/Legends|pauldron]] on their right [[Limb/Legends|shoulder]], while others wore plain white armor with [[Gold/Legends|gold]] markings, and no pauldron. Veteran assault troopers and assault trooper [[Squad/Legends|squad]] leaders, however, always wore white armor with gold markings. The choice of weapons would also vary throughout the ranks. The assault troopers with plain white armor made use of either [[E-11 carbine]]s or [[Elite carbine]]s as their primary choice of [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]], with [[DX-2 disruptor pistol/Legends|DX-2 disruptor pistols]] as their sidearm. Standard and veteran assault troopers who wore armor with the gold markings primarily used either E-11 [[Blaster carbine/Legends|carbines]], [[DXR6 carbine]]s, [[EE-3 carbine rifle/Legends|EE-3 carbine rifles]], or Elite carbines. For close ranged [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee]] combat, these troopers made use of either [[Stun baton/Legends|stun batons]], [[Survival knife|survival knives]], or [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblades]]. On the other hand, assault trooper squad leaders used either [[DLT-20A blaster rifle/Legends|DLT-20A]] or [[E-11 blaster rifle/Legends|E-11 blaster rifles]] as their primary weapon, and DX-2 [[Disruptor/Legends|disruptor]] [[Pistol/Legends|pistols]] or [[Scout trooper blaster pistol/Legends|scout blasters]] as their sidearm.<ref name="AED" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:AssaultTrooperPauldron.png|80px|thumb|An assault trooper wearing plain armor with a gray pauldron, while wielding an Elite carbine]]
[[W:c:swg:Veteran Assault Trooper|Assault troopers]] appeared as non-player characters in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> They could be found positioned around various [[W:c:swg:Galactic Empire|Imperial]] installations and wilderness locations. Two different graphical designs were used for this trooper. One featured all white armor with a dark gray pauldron, while the other featured all white armor with gold markings, and no pauldron. Early in the [[W:c:swg:Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided|game's]] lifespan, it was possible for Imperial players to spend [[W:c:swg:Faction point|faction points]] for an assault trooper "[[W:c:swg:Pet|faction pet]]" which could follow players around, and aid them in combat. These faction pets were adorned with the plain white armor and dark gray pauldron. Throughout the game, all the assault trooper, veteran assault trooper, assault trooper squad leader, and veteran assault trooper squad leader names appeared as fully capitalized when the player targetted or otherwise examined the NPCs.<ref name="AED" /> However, in a defunct, dynamically created [[W:c:swg:Rebel Alliance|Rebel]] escort [[W:c:swg:Quest|mission]] titled "Bothan SpyNet Post Attacked," the Spynet operative referred to "assault troopers" as lowercased, suggesting that the name of this particular stormtrooper should be lowercased during normal conversation. However, the possibility exists that the operative was merely referring to a generic group of assault troopers, rather than the specifically named group of specialized stormtroopers.<ref name="SpyNet" />
